cursed_scarecrow.review_note: Reviewed raw and alpha composite: pure magenta is technical matte between cloth/straw, not red eye or outfit color.

plains_spirit.review_note: Cyan/blue ghost and lantern; magenta islands are gaps between ribbons. Saturated pink flecks on spectral ribbons in dark/light preview are also matte contamination, not authored violet magic.

nature_guardian.review_note: Earth/moss/amber treant. Pure magenta is matte, no violet abilities. V2 completes antler tip and frame.

venom_spider.review_note: Brown/olive chitin and green venom. Magenta is only background between legs/webs. V3 has full framing, but overlapping far-side legs still require anatomy/rigging review; do not mark rig-ready.

forest_cultist.review_note: Reviewed raw: olive robes, ivory bone, green spell; magenta is gaps between antlers/ropes.

rotting_knight.review_note: Reviewed raw: iron/olive/slate with green visor; pure magenta is gaps in torn cloth.

gallows_wraith.review_note: Grey/ochre spectral figure, no magenta spell. Gaps in ribbons and hair are matte. Pink flecks observed in the dark/light composite on grey streamers and hair are matte contamination.

blackwood_executioner.review_note: Earth/iron/rust figure and orange visor, no magenta body detail. V2 restores full branch tips, axe and boots within the canvas.

bog_crawler.review_note: Olive/ochre reptile, no magenta body detail.

drowned_dead.review_note: Teal/slate/olive undead, pure magenta in hair/cloth gaps is background.

corrupted_bear.review_note: Reviewed numbered islands: preserve all interior magenta corruption and eyes; only remove exterior matte and boundary spill.

black_hart.review_note: Reviewed seven numbered islands: gaps between antlers and along chest/belly fur; pink corruption veins remain opaque. Boundary despill only, never global key.

swamp_witch.review_note: Raw reviewed: olive/brown clothing and natural skin, no magenta motif.

bone_crocodile.review_note: Raw reviewed: ivory/olive creature, magenta only in gaps. V2 reveals fourth hind leg and wider frame.

mist_walker.review_note: Raw reviewed: ochre/olive/bone creature, no magenta motif.

drowned_mother.review_note: Olive/brown/ivory and natural pale skin, magenta only in hair/garment gaps. V2 restores full staff tip and trailing cloth. Dark/light alpha preview revealed dark pink matte remnants in hair and between hanging strips; explicit local despill is authorized for those, not a costume recolor.

boneburner.review_note: Raw reviewed: charcoal/ivory/rust/ember orange; magenta only in cloth/limb gaps.

hearth_devourer.review_note: Raw reviewed: charcoal, ivory and orange flame; magenta only in gaps, no purple spell motif.

azhar.review_note: Raw reviewed: ochre/rust/ivory/bronze, no magenta elements.

frozen_castaway.review_note: Raw reviewed: navy/slate/ice-blue with painted frost, no magenta elements.

red_salamander.review_note: Raw reviewed: crimson/orange/amber reptile, pure magenta only in negative space, not flame color.
